title: Hi, I'm {{name}}
aboutText: Web and Mobile Developer with +6 years of experience in fintech, crypto, and healthcare products. I worked on the first mobile app for InvertirOnline using React Native and led the development of RipioTrade from scratch, supporting the team in its migration from native technologies. I enjoy working in a team, sharing knowledge, and adding value in high-performance environments. Experience with multicultural teams. Looking for simple solutions to not so simple problems.
bioFallback: I build web and mobile products focused on performance, scalability, and clean UX.
